Poly Haven states: "Our assets are all licensed as CC0, which is effectively
Public Domain even in jurisdictions that do not support the Public Domain."
Their licence page says the assets can be used for any purpose, including
commercial work, with no credit required, and that they can be redistributed
or included in a product you sell. Credit is appreciated. The website's
terms of service cover the site itself, not the CC0 files.

This file is a copy of that statement. Individual texture and HDRI downloads
do not contain a licence file.
